author: Nick Carter (mrnicholasbcarter-code); code merged in PR 968/972/1033

acceptance.criterion: verdict identify --passive --json reads all seven bounded GETs (the seventh is /v1/auto-combo/auto/candidates) with no model calls, and reports supply.complete with its named unknowns and the implementation pool counts

first_run.command: .venv/bin/python -m verdict identify --passive --json | jq -c '{mode, model_calls, gets: [.sources[] | {name, path, status}], source_errors, supply_complete: .supply.complete, supply_unknowns_count: (.supply.unknowns | length), supply_unknowns_named: [.supply.unknowns[] | select(startswith("limits_not_reported:") | not)], implementation_eligible: (.task_pools.implementation.eligible | length), implementation_eligible_free: ([.task_pools.implementation.eligible[] | select(.capacity == "free")] | length)}'

fresh_run.command: .venv/bin/python -m verdict identify --passive --json | jq -c '{mode, model_calls, gets: [.sources[] | {name, path, status}], source_errors, supply_complete: .supply.complete, supply_unknowns_count: (.supply.unknowns | length), supply_unknowns_named: [.supply.unknowns[] | select(startswith("limits_not_reported:") | not)], implementation_eligible: (.task_pools.implementation.eligible | length), implementation_eligible_free: ([.task_pools.implementation.eligible[] | select(.capacity == "free")] | length)}'

acceptance.criterion: After the passive timer ran from merged main, the verdict doctor identify report row shows the implementation pool and supply summary

first_run.command: .venv/bin/python -m verdict doctor --json | jq -c '{status, identify: [.sections[] | select(.label == "Identify passive report" or .label == "Identify timer") | {"label": .label, state, detail: (.detail | gsub("/home/[^ ;]*"; "<host-path>"))}]}'

fresh_run.command: .venv/bin/python -m verdict doctor --json | jq -c '{status, identify: [.sections[] | select(.label == "Identify passive report" or .label == "Identify timer") | {"label": .label, state, detail: (.detail | gsub("/home/[^ ;]*"; "<host-path>"))}]}'

stays_true_job: verdict-identify.timer runs `verdict identify --passive --json --save-report` on its schedule, and verdict-acceptance.timer runs `verdict doctor --json` hourly, which reports the identify row

setup_doctor.command: .venv/bin/python -m verdict doctor --json | jq -c '{status, issues, warnings, gateway: [.capability_bootstrap.capabilities[] | select(.capability_id | startswith("gateway.")) | {capability_id, status, health}]}'
